label: HA Bridge
info: HA Bridge v1.3.0 (see version.json / CHANGELOG.md). Publishes all HeishaMoNR settings + automation states to MQTT with Home Assistant auto-discovery, and keeps itself up to date from GitHub ([Check for updates] / [Update from GitHub] on the dashboard tab). Edit the MQTT out node if the broker is not pre-filled.

label: Check for updates
tooltip: Fetches this repo's pinned version.json (cache-busted) and shows the result in the [Update status] field. Nothing changes; [Update from GitHub] applies the update when one is available.

name: Update from GitHub
label: Update from GitHub
tooltip: Applies the bridge update when a newer version was found. Downloads the pinned flow file, validates it, replaces only the HA Bridge nodes and deploys atomically; the flow restarts afterwards. Admin credentials, if needed, come from the HAB_ADMIN_USER / HAB_ADMIN_PASS env vars.
